brave little things to do
alone this year

1. book a table for one
at a beautiful restaurant

2. go to a museum
late opening

3. take a dance class
where you know no one

4. ask a stranger for their
favourite book

5. walk a marked trail alone,
phone in your pocket

6. learn something new
every night, just for you
